_: Written by `ci-video narrate`. Records which line each mp3 is a read of, in which voice, on which engine, at what prosody — so a later edit to any of those can be detected instead of silently keeping the old recording. Commit this with the mp3s.

open.text: An embodied AI that runs in a browser tab.

ftue-first-run.text: First load asks for your microphone. Skip it and type instead.

ftue-hud-shell.text: Past the modal, the avatar is already live, with the HUD around it.

promise.text: The empty log makes the promise before you have typed anything at all.

one-turn.text: Type a message. The reply lands in the log, and the same reply drives the mouth, the face and a body clip.

quiet-hud.text: Hide the dock and the screen is just the avatar and one input.

connection.text: Point it at your own Ollama, or a proxy, or leave it entirely offline.

on-device.text: One of the five providers runs the model inside the browser tab itself.

environment.text: Or put a room around it. The seventies datacenter ships with the app.

stage-room.text: In the room the camera sits further back, so the whole body comes into frame.

recap.text: Forty-seven body clips, five ways to connect a model, and no monthly fee.

close.text: Spatial Companion, from Companion Intelligence. UnCloud your life.

a-room.text: Put a room around it, and the camera steps back far enough to bring the whole body into frame.

what-stays-yours.text: Five ways to connect a model, a clip library of forty-seven, and a voice that needs no backend at all. None of it needs an account.
